visual.name: atlynHeatmap
visual.description: A general row-by-column analytical heatmap with explicit color scales, safe optional shares, and model-backed selections.

en-US.Format_Additive: Value is a nonnegative additive measure
en-US.Format_AdditiveHelp: Author assertion. Allows computed shares of observed cells only. Never enable for ratios, averages or distinct counts.
en-US.Title: Atlyn Heatmap
en-US.Loading: Loading more rows; current data is incomplete.
en-US.FetchRejected: The host declined more data. Current data remains incomplete.
en-US.FetchFailed: The host data request failed. Current data remains incomplete.
en-US.FetchStalled: No additional cells were returned. Current data remains incomplete.
en-US.FetchPending: A data request is pending. The host has not yet delivered the next segment.
en-US.Partial: Incomplete / possibly reduced data. Domains cover loaded cells only; computed shares are disabled.
en-US.Complete: Host-delivered matrix; report filters and host query reductions still apply.
en-US.Tiny: Enlarge the tile to view the heatmap (at least 180 x 120 px).
en-US.Empty: No row-by-column observations in the current filter context.
en-US.Help: Arrow keys: navigate. Home/End: row edges; Ctrl+Home/End: grid edges. Page Up/Down: visible rows. Enter/Space: select. Ctrl/Cmd+select: multiselect. Escape: clear. Shift+F10: context menu.
en-US.LocalDomain: Each group has its own domain. Colors are not comparable between groups. Focus or hover a cell for its exact bounds.
en-US.LocalWarning: Colors are not comparable between groups.
en-US.RawSemantics: Raw model values; no denominator or totals computed.
en-US.RowSemantics: Share of row: denominator is the sum of observed finite, nonnegative values in that row; BLANK and absent cells are excluded.
en-US.ColumnSemantics: Share of column: denominator is the sum of observed finite, nonnegative values in that column; BLANK and absent cells are excluded.
en-US.AllSemantics: Share of all cells: denominator is the sum of observed finite, nonnegative values in the delivered matrix; BLANK and absent cells are excluded.
en-US.DenominatorSemantics: Value / supplied denominator: the model's positive denominator at each intersection. No sum is computed; scope is defined by that measure.
en-US.Key: 0 = observed zero; B = BLANK; - = absent intersection; ? = unloaded/unknown; ! = invalid; n/a = unavailable share.
en-US.NoIdentity: Some categories lack host identities. Selection is unavailable for those headers and cells.
en-US.NoSelection: This item has no complete host identity and cannot be selected.
en-US.InteractionDisabled: Report interactions are disabled by the host.
en-US.SelectionFailed: The host could not apply this selection.
en-US.ContextFailed: The host could not open the context menu.
en-US.RenderFailed: The heatmap could not render the host data.
en-US.HighContrast: High contrast: colors replaced with host foreground/background; values and state symbols remain visible.
en-US.Highlights: Incoming highlights are outlined with a dot; excluded cells have dashed borders, not faded text. Colors still encode the base value.
en-US.Data_Binding: Add one Row field, one Column field, and one numeric Value measure.
en-US.Data_Structure: The host returned an invalid matrix structure.
en-US.Data_Fields: Use exactly one Row field and one Column field; additional category hierarchy levels are not supported.
en-US.Data_Measures: Use one numeric Value, at most one numeric Denominator, and up to three tooltip measures.
en-US.Data_Hierarchy: Additional category hierarchy levels are not supported.
en-US.Data_Leaves: The host returned too many measure leaves for a column.
en-US.Data_Segment: The host supplied a data segment; some intersections may not be loaded.
en-US.Data_Reduced: The host reports data reduction; the matrix may be incomplete.
en-US.Data_Columns: The 100-column host limit was reached; additional columns may be omitted.
en-US.Data_Cap: The displayed matrix is capped at 500 rows, 100 columns, and 20,000 cells.
en-US.Data_Processing: The matrix hierarchy exceeds the safe processing limit; remaining categories were not loaded.
en-US.Data_Partial: Computed shares are unavailable while the data is incomplete; supplied model denominators remain usable.
en-US.Data_Empty: No category intersections were returned for the current filters.
en-US.Data_Index: The host returned an invalid matrix measure index.
en-US.Analysis_Complete: Computed shares require complete data. Load all data or use raw values.
en-US.Analysis_BindDenominator: Bind a numeric Denominator measure to calculate ratios.
en-US.Analysis_Denominator: Ratios require a finite positive denominator and a finite result; unavailable ratios are not shown as zero.
en-US.Analysis_Additive: Share normalization requires explicit confirmation that Value is additive. Rates and ratios must not be summed.
en-US.Analysis_ShareScope: Share normalization supports only nonnegative additive values. BLANK and absent intersections are excluded, not treated as zero.
en-US.Analysis_InvalidGroup: Share normalization is unavailable for groups containing negative, invalid, or unloaded values.
en-US.Analysis_ZeroGroup: Shares are unavailable for zero-total groups; a zero total is not a percentage denominator.
